name: Recommended Training Pathways v0.1
assumptions: Foundation and L1 selections reviewed by the programme sponsor on 1 November 2026. All other pathways are AI recommendation - to be reviewed. The same Foundation/L1 courses are completed once. Internal learning remains proposed and contributes to planned teaching only. Full-course durations and upper bounds are used, with shared courses, outcomes and internal time deduplicated. Budgets, delivery dates and accountable owners are unset pending planning. Levels describe work with agents, independently of role and seniority. TR-229 Reasoning with o1 is excluded by user instruction; TR-127 remains excluded. This is a separate recommended-pathways deliverable, not a replacement app default or an annual delivery plan.

components.name: Foundation

internal.title: AI use cases
internal.outcomes: A training that showcases what AI does today in cyber by showing existing use in our organization, discuss about planned future development and beyond.

components.rationale: Reviewed. User-selected shared Foundation/L1 courses TR-281 and TR-145, plus the saved AI use cases internal brief. The courses sit in Foundation for reuse and are counted once. Review confirms the selection, not full outcome coverage, learner competence or delivery readiness.
components.reviewBasis: User-selected shared Foundation/L1 courses TR-281 and TR-145, plus the saved AI use cases internal brief. The courses sit in Foundation for reuse and are counted once. Review confirms the selection, not full outcome coverage, learner competence or delivery readiness.

components.name: L1 Entry
components.rationale: Reviewed. User-reviewed Foundation/L1 bundle inherited from Foundation. No additional L1 course or historical internal exercise is assigned. The same course evidence is evaluated against L1 outcomes without repeating learning time.
components.reviewBasis: User-reviewed Foundation/L1 bundle inherited from Foundation. No additional L1 course or historical internal exercise is assigned. The same course evidence is evaluated against L1 outcomes without repeating learning time.

components.name: L2 Practitioner

internal.title: Supervise, intervene and recover
internal.outcomes:
Teaching and practice: Define autonomy and escalation; inspect traces; inject a tool/output failure; stop, revoke and recover.

Expected learner evidence: Correctly delegate, monitor, intervene, recover and record the human decision.

Prerequisites: Seeded failure traces, validated recovery path, scoped permissions.
internal.source: Historical proposal; not a delivery commitment

internal.title: Create, own and retire a shared Skill
internal.outcomes:
Teaching and practice: Create a focused Skill; attach tests and failure modes; peer-review permissions; assign monthly review and retirement rules.

Expected learner evidence: Submit a tested Skill, named owner, provenance, connector decision, change triggers and deprecation procedure.

Prerequisites: Agreed template, library workflow, approved connector list and notification route.
internal.source: Historical proposal; not a delivery commitment

internal.title: Domain benchmarks and release checks
internal.outcomes:
Teaching and practice: Build small normal/adversarial test sets; compare a baseline and a change; interpret failures and release checks.

Expected learner evidence: Retain expected answers, failure classes, acceptance criteria and a release/reject decision.

Prerequisites: Sanitised tasks, reviewed answer key and evaluation harness.
internal.source: Historical proposal; not a delivery commitment

internal.title: Observed supervision sign-off
internal.outcomes:
Teaching and practice: Integrated blind task, failure injection, evidence review and feedback.

Expected learner evidence: Complete the task with safe intervention; any critical control failure requires remediation and reassessment.

Prerequisites: Calibrated assessors and rubric; operational permission is separately approved.
internal.source: Historical proposal; not a delivery commitment

components.rationale: AI recommendation - to be reviewed. Evaluating AI Agents develops tracing and evaluation; Agent Skills develops reusable instructions; OWASP guidance adds agent-security context. Complete the courses before the internal supervision, Skill, benchmark and observed-assessment exercises. TR-100 requires basic Python; use the coached alternative where unsuitable.

components.name: L3 Expert

internal.title: Build, evaluate and deploy a scoped agent
internal.outcomes:
Teaching and practice: Define task and alternatives; build workflow; compare cost/latency; use human-labelled tests; aggregate errors; plan hosting, monitoring and rollback.

Expected learner evidence: Demonstrate versioned agent, reproducible evaluation, human-calibrated judgements, error analysis and release/stop decision.

Prerequisites: Approved scaffold, synthetic data, current APIs, security/identity experts available; prerequisites confirmed.
internal.source: Historical proposal; not a delivery commitment

internal.title: Independent builder challenge
internal.outcomes:
Teaching and practice: Unseen change and failure challenge; review evidence, monitoring and rollback; assess or return for remediation.

Expected learner evidence: Defend build/buy/model choice, detect drift and demonstrate a safe correction or withdrawal.

Prerequisites: Blind cases, calibrated rubric and approved testing environment.
internal.source: Historical proposal; not a delivery commitment
